name: Zigbee2MQTT

url.help: Address of the Zigbee2MQTT frontend (frontend port, default 8080).

setup:
For Zigbee2MQTT running outside Home Assistant (Docker, LXC, another host). As a Home Assistant add-on it has its own sidebar entry already.

Turn on the frontend in the Zigbee2MQTT configuration (`frontend: enabled: true`, port 8080) and make sure Home Assistant can reach that port. Admins only by default: the frontend can pair, rename and remove devices. With `frontend: auth_token` set, it asks for the token once.
